title.zh: 将三宝颜锡布格省 Tungawan 市镇 San Isidro 描笼涯的 Tungawan 国立中学的 San Isidro 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tungawan National High School - San Isidro Annex in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Tungawan, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay From the Tungawan National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as San Isidro National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Tungawan National High School - San Isidro Annex in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Tungawan, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay From the Tungawan National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to Be Known as San Isidro National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu San Isidro của Trường Trung học Tungawan Quốc gia tại Barangay San Isidro, Đô thị Tungawan, Tỉnh Zamboanga Sibugay khỏi Trường Trung học Tungawan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học San Isidro Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต San Isidro ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tungawan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Isidro เทศบาล Tungawan จังหวัด Zamboanga Sibugay ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tungawan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Isidro แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus San Isidro, Sekolah Menengah Tungawan Nasional di Barangay San Isidro, Kotamadya Tungawan, Provinsi Zamboanga Sibugay dari Sekolah Menengah Tungawan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah San Isidro Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus San Isidro, Sekolah Menengah Tungawan Kebangsaan di Barangay San Isidro, Perbandaran Tungawan, Wilayah Zamboanga Sibugay daripada Sekolah Menengah Tungawan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah San Isidro Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Tungawan National High School - San Isidro Annex in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Tungawan, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay is hereby separated from the Tungawan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as San Isidro National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tungawan National High School - San Isidro Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the San Isidro National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the San Isidro National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Tungawan National High School - San Isidro Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
